root_cause: Round-4 multi-second p90 that grew with duration was caused by a len(words)*280 ms segment cap that crushed each line to ~1.4 s. Absolute MMS timebase at 30/120/240 s was already fine.
fix: Neighbor-clamped LRCLIB line windows (±1.5 s), emission frame_ms from tensor length, 40 ms MMS lag compensate, per-line first-word agreement gate with LRCLIB fallback, monotonic interp inside the line only. Marker [drome-aligned:v4-ctc-line].

timebase_selftest.tolerance_note: 30 ms not achievable with a single lag compensate across 30/120/240 s (signed residuals go both ways). Honest floor ~40 ms.

round5_synth_full_demucs.note: Full-length TTS over music bed, Demucs vocals, scored vs TTS truth. demucs=true only when generate.json reports demucs; seconds_demucs recorded per variant. No previews, no CTC self-score, no allow_no_demucs in official run.
round5_synth_full_demucs.verdict: All six variants meet median≤60 / p90≤150 / |drift|≤30. Align default remains false; Charles enables.
